en.headline: Police seek public help to find girl missing from Sau Mau Ping
en.dek: Officers appealed on Thursday for information on a 14-year-old who left an On Tai Estate flat on Saturday afternoon and has not been seen since.
body: Police on Thursday asked the public for information about a 14-year-old girl who left her home at On Tai Estate in Sau Mau Ping on Saturday afternoon and has not been accounted for.

The Kowloon East Missing Person Investigation Unit said the family reported her missing on Monday, two days after she last left the flat. Officers released a description of the girl as about 1.6 metres tall, of slim build, with a pointed face, a yellow complexion and long black hair. When last seen she was wearing a black short-sleeved top, brown trousers and white sports shoes.
Anyone who has seen the girl or has information was asked to call 3661 0316, contact the Kowloon East Missing Person Investigation Unit, or report to any police station.

zh.headline: 警方籲市民提供秀茂坪失蹤女童消息
zh.dek: 一名14歲女童上周六下午離開安泰邨住所後失蹤，家人周一報案，警方周四公開呼籲市民提供線索。
body: 警方周四呼籲市民提供一名秀茂坪失蹤女童的消息。該名14歲女童上周六下午離開安泰邨住所後便告失蹤。
東九龍總區失蹤人口調查組表示，女童家人於周一報案，即她離開住所兩日後。警方形容女童身高約1.6米，瘦身材，尖面型，黃皮膚，蓄長黑髮；最後露面時身穿黑色短袖上衣、啤色長褲及白色運動鞋。
任何人如有該女童的消息或曾見過她，可致電3661 0316，聯絡東九龍總區失蹤人口調查組，或向任何一間警署報案。
